title: Gmail AI agent: drafts, sorts and follows up | 50agents
description: A Gmail AI agent reads new email, drafts replies for your OK, sorts labels and logs invoices. Tell Captain the job once; 50agents runs it.
h1: A Gmail AI agent that clears your inbox chores for you
answer: With 50agents, a Gmail AI agent reads new email, drafts replies in your voice, labels and files messages, pulls out attachments and logs what matters to a sheet, across the 2,300+ apps your business already uses.
You tell Captain the job in one sentence, check the plan it shows, and it runs on its own against your Gmail, with anything going out to customers waiting for your approval.

faqs.q: Will an AI agent send email from my Gmail without asking?
faqs.a: Not by default. Anything going to people outside your business waits in Needs you until you approve it, and an AI agent asks before sending until you allow it in Settings. Drafts saved with “Create Email Draft” sit in your Gmail drafts until you send them.

faqs.q: Can it reply inside the same thread?
faqs.a: Yes. “Reply To Thread” answers an existing conversation and lets you pick the recipients, the sender, everyone or specific people, so the reply stays with the thread. “Get Thread Replies” lets it read the thread first.

faqs.q: Can a new email start the work?
faqs.a: Yes. “New Email Arrives” starts an automation or an AI agent, filtered by label, sender or subject, and “New Attachment” starts it when a message carries a file.

faqs.q: Can it sort my email into labels?
faqs.a: Yes. “Modify Email Labels” adds or removes labels on a message or a whole thread. An AI agent can read each new email and decide the label, and an automation can label by sender or subject the same way every time.

faqs.q: Can it follow up when someone has not replied?
faqs.a: Yes. “New Email Sent” starts the work from your Sent mailbox, “Search_Email_Messages” finds threads, and “Get Thread Replies” checks whether anyone answered. If nobody did, it drafts the nudge with “Reply To Thread” for you to approve.

faqs.q: Can it pull invoices and files out of my emails?
faqs.a: Yes. “New Attachment” finds messages that carry files, and “Get Email Attachment” returns each file's name, type and link so the next step can read it, save it or log it to a sheet.

faqs.q: Is a new email picked up straight away?
faqs.a: No, on a schedule. “New Email Arrives”, “New Attachment” and “New Email Sent” are checked at intervals, not pushed the second mail lands, so there is a short delay.

faqs.q: Do I need to write code or build a flowchart?
faqs.a: No. You write the job in a sentence, Captain shows the plan in plain words, and you change any step by saying so.
